channel.title: Carson Antiques & Collectibles Mall — Blog

item.title: How to start a coin collection: a beginner's field guide
item.description: How to start a coin collection: the first five steps, silver dates, the 1–70 grading scale, why never to clean coins, and where to hunt in Carson City.

item.title: Is my vintage china valuable? Flip it over first.
item.description: Most vintage china sells for less than you'd hope. Here's how to read the backstamp, check condition, name the pattern and find real sold prices.

item.title: How to spot a real vintage sign in five minutes, right in the booth
item.description: Real porcelain signs are glass fused to iron or steel, one color at a time. Here's a 5-minute in-booth check for chips, rust, grommets and modern fakes.
